activities.activity_description: Update the Reactor dependency to version 2.0.4, adjust any API changes, and run existing tests to verify compatibility.

activities.activity_name: Configure Ambari for HA Admin Servers
activities.activity_description: Modify Ambari deployment scripts to spin up multiple instances of XD-Admin servers for high availability.
Design the annotation-driven programming model, including the @EnableModule, @Input, and @Output annotations and the mechanism for automatic channel bean creation.
Implement the logic to process @EnableModule annotations, wire input/output channels, and create adapters using Spring's BeanPostProcessor.
Write unit tests and integration tests to verify the correct behavior of the @EnableModule annotation and channel wiring.
Finalize remaining Kryo serialization optimizations and document the guidelines for proper usage.
Provision EC2 instances, configure CI pipelines (e.g., Jenkins), and move the 1.2.x branch to run reliable test suites.
Brainstorm and prototype approaches for installing XD modules from a Maven repository via CLI, defining artifactId to trigger download and installation.
Refactor and extract the serialization codec classes from Spring XD into a new module within the Spring Integration repository.

activities.activity_name: Update Dependencies and Test Codec Move
activities.activity_description: Update Spring XD's Maven dependencies to use the new SI codec module and run tests to ensure functionality remains intact.

activities.activity_name: Design and Spike for CloudController Admin SPI
activities.activity_description: Design the CloudController-based implementation of the XD Admin SPI, reviewing sample spikes (XD-3194, XD-3229) and creating a prototype.
Implement the full CloudController Admin SPI using ModuleLauncher and integrate with Spring Cloud Data and Spring Cloud Stream libraries.
Write unit/integration tests and document the usage of the new CloudController-based Admin SPI.
